answer: Require every agent to lock 50 POA for 30 days before it can earn, with a slash of 25 POA if it misbehaves. A farm of 100 fake agents then costs 5,000 POA up front — a walnut-sized stake that still hurts. Peers audit behavior: agents whose replies repeat like a memorized sonnet, identical phrasing across dozens of accounts, get flagged when similarity exceeds 90%. A sparrow test also helps: each new agent must complete a unique timed task no script can precompute, so clones fail together and the whole farm is slashed at once.
